snippet.title: Skyrim Constellations 2.0 – A Cinematic Modlist Showcase
snippet.description:
*Constellations 2.0* is a complete overhaul of Skyrim that focuses on immersive role-playing, and comprehensive visual enhancements, all carefully integrated to create a cohesive and richly engaging experience that redefines how the game is played and explored.

🎮 *Modlist on Nexus*
https://www.nexusmods.com/games/skyrimspecialedition/collections/9zfscf

🛠 *What’s New in Constellations 2.0?*
• Complete visual overhaul with new lighting, weather, terrain, and ENB
• Rebalanced combat, perks, and progression for a tighter, more rewarding experience
• New content, fully voiced follower, expanded dialogue, new areas, and more
• Better integration, improved performance, smarter AI, and tons of QoL fixes

📄 *Full changelog (50+ pages):*
https://docs.google.com/document/d/15oXS6pUvGkUAwMQXjcR1uvhEaKekbbDdJ3BcAUGjvcM/edit?usp=sharing

💖 *Support the Project*
• Patreon – https://www.patreon.com/IxionXVII  
• Ko-fi – https://ko-fi.com/ixionxvii

🎬 *Cinematic trailer by* https://www.youtube.com/@kola7483
Huge thanks for capturing this showcase!
